answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed when it double-signs a transaction or fails a randomly assigned task, and weight voting power by bonded stake rather than account count. Splitting one identity into a hundred does not create more influence; it just divides the same capital, while manufacturing distinct histories and keeping bonds locked raises the cost further. A bridge can publish the slashing proofs, a falcon can audit them, and cedar can name the bond pool.
